result.final_text:
## What this letter says
You had a breast X-ray [mammogram] on 16 September 2026. The hospital wants to check you again. Being called back does not mean you have cancer. About 4 in 5 women called back do not have cancer.

## What you need to do
1. Go to your appointment on 7 October 2026 at 11:00 at the Breast Assessment Clinic, Eastmoor Hospital.
2. You may have more breast X-rays at the appointment.
3. You may also have an ultrasound [sound wave pictures] and a biopsy [tiny tissue sample].
4. Plan to stay for up to 4 hours.
5. You can bring a friend or family member.
6. If you cannot come, call 01632 960 733 right away.

## Dates and medicines
- Your first breast X-ray: 16 September 2026
- Your follow-up appointment: 7 October 2026 at 11:00
- Location: Breast Assessment Clinic, Eastmoor Hospital
- No medicines in this letter

## Questions to ask your doctor
- What did the first X-ray show?
- What happens if the new tests find something?
- Can I get results before I leave?

## When to get urgent help
The letter does not list specific warning signs.

If you are worried and it is not an emergency, call NHS 111. In an emergency, call 999.

---
*This explanation was made by a computer program to help you read your letter. It may contain mistakes. It does not replace your doctor, nurse or pharmacist. Always follow the letter and ask them if anything is unclear.*
